notes.title: WHO IS AWESOME Released!
notes.notes:
[b]WHO IS AWESOME[/b] is a singleplayer mini-game collection, in which the most awesome character that you choose competes with the characters that you didn’t.

Four characters from different games — Reaper from [b]Peace, Death![/b], Vladimir from [b]DRAW CHILLY[/b], Knight from [b]OH MY GOD, LOOK AT THIS KNIGHT![/b], and the Cowboy from [b]Gun Done[/b] — sit at the same table and try to think faster than their opponents.

[h1]The game has only two rules[/h1]
[list]
[*]Rule number one: if you lose, the others will win.
[*]Rule number two: if you win, the others will lose.
[/list]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7wJLAZgyuT4

notes.title: Special 20% DRAW CHILLY discount for Peace, Death! owners
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33751114/3994ccd1e9e048db90fcaf0fab7f1a9be0e28328.png[/img]

How is it going, Reapers!

Hope you’re enjoying deciding fates of your clients in Peace, Death! I have some great news for all the Apocalypse Inc. employees out there, as I'm proud to announce the release of a Peace, Death! spin-off - DRAW CHILLY. When will it be available for a purchase? 
Well, right now actually! 

For all the Peace, Death! Owners there's a special offer: 20% off DRAW CHILLY. 
Grab your copy now and raise a whole CITY from the depths of Purgatory by a request from your well known allies - four Horsemen of the Apocalypse. 

DRAW CHILLY tells the tale of Vladimir and his squad of brave, pure-hearted, yet occasionally hapless mechanics. They’re tasked with a monumental ordeal - to raise an ENTIRE CITY from the pits of hell! On their way to the top, they’ll have to battle evil monkeys, Grim Reaper cats and other otherworldly creatures. Their ultimate goal - to deliver bosses, who have ended up in Purgatory by mistake, into the hands of the Reapers, so they can be sent back to Hell.

For Peace, Death! owners: you can turn on the special Reaper in your squad. Just go to Settings page in game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33751114/ac580d855f5fb8255440fc3635d9bc1fb0a1f091.gif[/img]

Have fun, Reapers! Ouch, i mean, Vladimir!
